message.content:
Build the storefront quiz widget as a Shopify theme app extension.

## Directory structure to create:
```
extensions/quiz-widget/
├── blocks/
│   └── quiz-embed.liquid
├── assets/
│   ├── quiz-widget.js
│   └── quiz-widget.css
└── snippets/
    └── quiz-popup.liquid
```

Also create the extension config: `extensions/quiz-widget/shopify.extension.toml`

## 1. shopify.extension.toml
```toml
api_version = "2025-10"

[[extensions]]
type = "theme"
name = "QuizSnap Quiz Widget"

  [[extensions.blocks]]
  name = "Quiz Embed"
  target = "section"
  template = "blocks/quiz-embed"
```

## 2. blocks/quiz-embed.liquid
- Online Store 2.0 app block
- Schema with settings:
  - `quiz_slug` (text, required) — the quiz to display
  - `display_mode` (select: embedded/popup/slide-in, default embedded)
  - `button_text` (text, default "Take the quiz")
  - `button_color` (color, default "#5C6AC4")
  - `width` (select: full/medium/narrow, default full)
- Renders a container div with data attributes
- Includes the JS and CSS assets
- For popup mode: renders a trigger button
- For embedded mode: renders inline container

## 3. assets/quiz-widget.js (~400 lines, MUST be under 20KB gzipped)
This is the core storefront runtime. It:

**Initialization:**
- Self-executing function (IIFE), no global pollution
- Finds all `[data-quizsnap-quiz]` elements on the page
- Reads config from data attributes (slug, shop, display mode)
- Fetches quiz data from the app's public API: `GET /api/quiz/{slug}?shop={shop}`

**Quiz Renderer:**
- Renders quiz one question at a time (conversational flow)
- Progress bar at top (if enabled in quiz settings)
- Question title + description
- Type-specific input renderers:
  - multiple-choice: clickable option cards (radio/checkbox behavior)
  - image-choice: image grid with selection
  - dropdown: native select element
  - slider: range input with labels
  - email: email input + consent checkbox
  - text-input: text field
  - rating: star/number rating selector
- Next/Back navigation buttons
- Handles conditional logic (uses logic rules from quiz data)

**Submission:**
- Collects all answers
- POSTs to `/api/quiz/{slug}/submit?shop={shop}` with:
  ```json
  { "sessionId": "uuid", "answers": [...], "email": "...", "source": "embed", "deviceType": "desktop|mobile" }
  ```
- Displays result page with recommended products
- Each product: image, title, price, "Add to cart" or "View product" button

**Key design principles:**
- Vanilla JS only (no frameworks, no jQuery)
- Minimal DOM manipulation
- CSS classes for all styling (no inline styles from JS)
- Responsive (mobile-first)
- Accessible (keyboard navigation, aria labels, focus management)
- < 20KB gzipped total

## 4. assets/quiz-widget.css (~200 lines)
- CSS custom properties for theming:
  ```css
  .quizsnap { --qs-primary: #5C6AC4; --qs-text: #1a1a1a; --qs-bg: #fff; --qs-border: #e5e5e5; --qs-radius: 8px; }
  ```
- Quiz container (.quizsnap)
- Progress bar (.quizsnap-progress)
- Question display (.quizsnap-question)
- Answer options (.quizsnap-option, .quizsnap-option--selected)
- Image choice grid (.quizsnap-image-grid)
- Slider (.quizsnap-slider)
- Email form (.quizsnap-email)
- Navigation (.quizsnap-nav, .quizsnap-btn)
- Results page (.quizsnap-results)
- Product cards (.quizsnap-product)
- Loading state (.quizsnap-loading)
- Responsive breakpoints (mobile < 768px)
- Smooth transitions/animations

## 5. snippets/quiz-popup.liquid
- Popup/slide-in variant
- Trigger button
- Overlay container
- Close button
- Uses same JS widget but in modal mode

## IMPORTANT RULES:
- Widget JS must be under 20KB gzipped
- No external dependencies
- Works in all modern browsers
- Accessible (WCAG 2.1 AA)
- Mobile responsive
- CSS custom properties for easy theming
- The widget reads shop from `Shopify.shop` global or from a data attribute

First delete the `extensions/.gitkeep` file, then create all files.

WRITE all files.

content.text:
All 5 files created successfully. Here is the complete summary:

---

## What was built

### File paths created

- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/extensions/quiz-widget/shopify.extension.toml`
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/extensions/quiz-widget/blocks/quiz-embed.liquid`
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/extensions/quiz-widget/assets/quiz-widget.js`
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/extensions/quiz-widget/assets/quiz-widget.css`
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/extensions/quiz-widget/snippets/quiz-popup.liquid`

The `.gitkeep` file was deleted before creating the extension.

---

### Size budget (gzipped)
| File | Raw | Gzipped | Budget |
|---|---|---|---|
| `quiz-widget.js` | 33KB | **7.8KB** | <15KB |
| `quiz-widget.css` | 21KB | **3.9KB** | <5KB |

---

### Architecture decisions

**`shopify.extension.toml`** — Declares the theme extension as type `"theme"` with handle `"quizsnap-quiz-widget"` and a single section-targeted block.

**`blocks/quiz-embed.liquid`** — Online Store 2.0 app block with four merchant settings (`quiz_slug`, `display_mode`, `button_text`, `button_color`, `width`). It branches on `display_mode`: inline renders a `[data-quizsnap-quiz]` container directly; popup/slide-in renders a trigger button plus a hidden overlay `<dialog>`-style `div`. The widget JS is lazy-loaded via a one-time `<script>` injection using a `data-quizsnap-loaded` guard so multiple blocks on a page share one script download. The block shows a dashed placeholder in Design Mode when no slug is configured.

**`assets/quiz-widget.js`** — Full IIFE, zero external dependencies. The `QuizSnapWidget` class drives a state machine (`LOADING` → `ACTIVE` → `COMPLETE` | `ERROR`). Key behaviors:
- Quiz data fetched from `/api/quiz/:slug?shop=` with `sessionStorage` cache (5-minute TTL)
- All 8 question types rendered (`multiple-choice`, `image-choice`, `slider`, `text-input`, `email`, `date`, `dropdown`, `rating`)
- Skip logic evaluated per-question using the `logic.rules` JSON array from the API — supports both question-level logic rules and per-answer `nextQuestionId` overrides
- Required-field validation with inline error messages linked via `role="alert"`
- Full selection state preserved when user navigates Back
- Analytics events (`quiz_started`, `quiz_completed`, `product_clicked`) are fire-and-forget — never block the quiz flow
- Popup/slide-in: full focus trap (Tab/Shift-Tab cycling), Escape key dismissal, `aria-hidden` toggling, `overflow:hidden` on `body`
- `boot()` function initializes all `[data-quizsnap-quiz]` containers and all trigger wrappers on `DOMContentLoaded`

**`assets/quiz-widget.css`** — CSS custom properties on `.quizsnap` (`--qs-primary`, `--qs-text`, `--qs-bg`, `--qs-border`, `--qs-radius`) allow per-block theming via the `style` attribute set by Liquid. Popup panel slides up from bottom on mobile (sheet pattern) and centers as a modal on desktop. Slide-in enters from the right on desktop and also sheets from bottom on mobile. All transitions respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.

**`snippets/quiz-popup.liquid`** — Reusable Liquid snippet for triggering a popup quiz from outside an app block (e.g., inside a theme section or page template). Accepts the same parameters as the block settings via `{% render %}` arguments. Generates a unique ID from the slug + current timestamp to avoid collisions when included multiple times.
